messages:
Sara: Quick coord — trying to land a small clarity fix in the Quickstart 'first deploy' section: we currently show `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` in the docker/local example but don't call out that Dedicated/Private users should use KMS or a secrets store. Also the sample docker-compose has a placeholder that breaks if copied. PR ready at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459

Miguel: can you paste the exact snippet that's breaking? :eyes:

Sara: repro steps:
```
# in example repo
docker-compose up
ERROR: missing env var REDWOOD_API_KEY
```
Looks like compose file expects REDWOOD_API_KEY but the quickstart text suggests using the CLI login flow; ppl copy-paste and hit this.

Alex: ack — I remember flagging this. We should modify the snippet to use a `.env.example` and explicitly show `REDWOOD_API_KEY=__REPLACE_ME__` and call out 'do not commit keys'.

Ben: I'll take the tiny PR changes (update compose + text). When do we need this? Do we want a patch release or land in main?

Sara: patch would be fine, docs-only. Miguel can you review the wording for the KMS mention? small one-liner under 'auth options'.

Miguel: yep, will push a suggestion to the PR. Also found a bad link to 'Private deployment guide' — currently points to `/private-deploy` --> should be `/private`.

docs-ci-bot: docs CI: linkcheck failed — 1 broken link (private-deploy) — see CI log: https://ci.redwood/links/459

Alex: tagging @eng-oncall? no need. Ben, do you want me to cut the docs release after merge? :white_check_mark:

Ben: please do. I'll queue a tiny changelog entry.

Sara: thanks — leaving instructions in PR for QA: steps to spin up compose with `.env.example`, verify error message improved, and confirm the Private link lands.

Miguel: pushed wording suggestion. PR now has 2 commits.

Ben: review done, merging after final CI pass.

Alex: merged. :tada:

Sara: deployed to staging docs site. Verified the example uses `.env.example` and the link goes to /private. Closing the thread. :rocket:
